case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: A single accused (the respondent, Madan Lal) is involved.

accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as male (he, his).

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for the accused.

victim_age.reason: Victim is described as aged about 7 years.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused, Madan Lal, met her and came to know
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment says only that they met on the way; it never calls him a stranger.

offence_category.reason: Offence is rape under s. 376(2)(f), with attempt under s. 511.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment cites s. 376(2)(f) r/w s. 511 and s. 354 IPC.

evidence_type.correct_value: Prosecutrix testimony, mother's account (who arrived after the cry), medical witness evidence, forensic examination of clothes
evidence_type.quote: Upon hearing the cry of the prosecutrix, her mother, Ramnali Bai, PW2, reached the spot
evidence_type.reason: Mother did not witness the act; the list also omits the forensic examination and the prosecutrix's testimony.

confession.reason: No confession is referred to; the accused abjured guilt.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Victim's tender age of seven; offence described as an assault on a woman's dignity and body
aggravating_circumstances.quote: the prosecutrix was a seven year old girl
aggravating_circumstances.reason: The judgment stresses the victim's age and gravity of the offence, which were not noted as aggravating.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Compromise between accused and victim's parents; custody already undergone (slightly more than one year)
mitigating_circumstances.quote: the learned Single Judge has been influenced by the compromise
mitigating_circumstances.reason: The High Court relied on the compromise and time served, which the judgment records as mitigating considerations.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under s. 376(2)(f) r/w 511 and sentenced to five years RI.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court converted to s. 354 and reduced sentence to time already undergone.

final_outcome.correct_value: Appeal partly allowed; High Court order set aside and matter remitted for fresh decision; no final conviction by Supreme Court
final_outcome.quote: the order of the High Court stands lancinated
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court did not convict; it set aside the High Court order and remitted the matter.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Not stated (matter remitted for reappraisal of evidence)
offence_finally_established.quote: we are inclined to set aside the judgment of the High Court and remit the matter to it for appropriate adjudication
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established; the Supreme Court remitted the matter for fresh decision.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Rigorous imprisonment (trial court); no final sentence imposed by Supreme Court
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed-term RI is the trial court sentence only; the final sentence was not imposed by the Supreme Court.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: 5 (trial court sentence); High Court reduced to time served; no final term imposed
imprisonment_years.reason: Five years is the trial court term only, not the final sentence.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate and do not reveal the Supreme Court outcome.

offence_severity.correct_value: Not stated (trial court sentence was five years RI)
offence_severity.reason: Value restates the sentence; the judgment does not classify offence severity.

attempt_completion.correct_value: Attempt (charged under s. 376(2)(f) r/w s. 511 IPC)
attempt_completion.quote: framed the charge under Section 376(2)(f) read with Section 511 of IPC
attempt_completion.reason: Section 511 concerns attempt; the charge was for attempt, not completed rape.

physical_harm.correct_value: Prosecution alleged discharge on her private parts and stomach; no injuries described
physical_harm.quote: he discharged on her private parts as well as on the stomach
physical_harm.reason: Injuries are not described; only the alleged discharge is mentioned.

number_of_offences.correct_value: One offence charged under s. 376(2)(f) r/w s. 511 IPC; convicted by trial court; not upheld on appeal
number_of_offences.quote: set aside the conviction under Section 376(2)(f) read with Section 511
number_of_offences.reason: The conviction was not upheld; the High Court converted it and the Supreme Court remitted the matter.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss is mentioned.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Not stated; Supreme Court did not assess the evidence and remitted it for reappraisal
key_evidence_accepted.quote: we have not referred to the evidence of any of the witnesses
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Supreme Court expressly declined to examine the evidence and accepted nothing.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Trial court found the evidence credible; the Supreme Court made no credibility finding; High Court's failure to consider contradictions was counsel's submission
witness_credibility.quote: the prosecution had been able to bring home the charge on the base of credible evidence
witness_credibility.reason: The Supreme Court recorded the trial court's finding and the appellant's submission, not its own assessment.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused fled (took to his heels) when the victim's mother arrived
post_offence_conduct.quote: then accused took to his heels
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment records that the accused fled when the mother arrived.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment states the period undergone is slightly more than one year.

bail_history.reason: Bail history is not stated; respondent was in custody.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence date 27.12.2008; High Court decision 01.02.2010; Supreme Court decision 01.07.2015; trial court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 01.02.2010 in CRA No. 808/2009
trial_duration.reason: The 01.02.2010 date is the High Court judgment, not the trial judgment, whose date is not given.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellant State: G.D. Singh, Apoorv Kurup, Shreya Dubey; Respondent: Asha Jain Madan (court-appointed)
legal_representation.quote: Asha Jain Madan (A.G.) for the Respondent
legal_representation.reason: Dipak Misra is the judge, not counsel; Asha Jain Madan represented the respondent, not the accused's side as listed.

investigation_status.reason: FIR lodged, chargesheet filed and trial completed are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: High Court judgment was laconic, did not refer to evidence, and was influenced by a compromise in a non-compoundable offence
procedural_irregularity.quote: the learned Single Judge has been influenced by the compromise
procedural_irregularity.reason: The judgment identifies several procedural defects in the High Court's approach.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued the High Court ignored appellate jurisdiction, failed to reappreciate evidence, converted in a laconic manner, and criticised the sentence
prosecution_argument.quote: the High Court has not kept in mind the jurisdiction of the appellate court
prosecution_argument.reason: Value omits the State's appellate-jurisdiction argument and sentence criticism, and asserts a conviction-validity argument not recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: Respondent's counsel argued the High Court's conversion to s. 354 was defensible because ingredients of rape were not established
defence_argument.quote: the conversion of the offence to one under Section 354 IPC by the High Court cannot be found fault with
defence_argument.reason: The defence supported the High Court's conversion; it did not argue it was improper.

legal_principle_applied.reason: No compromise in rape cases and the appellate duty to reappreciate evidence are both stated.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Also relied on K. Anbazhagan (Criminal Appeal No. 637 of 2015), Ashok@Pappu, Phulki@Santosh@Makhan and Jeevan (distinguished or referred)
precedent_relied_upon.quote: K. Anbazhagan v. State of Karnataka and Others Criminal Appeal No.637 of 2015
precedent_relied_upon.reason: The list omits K. Anbazhagan and the three Madhya Pradesh High Court decisions cited.

sentencing_rationale.correct_value: No final sentence imposed; compromise cannot justify lenient sentence; High Court order set aside and remitted
sentencing_rationale.quote: the compromise that has been entered into between the accused and the parents of the victim
sentencing_rationale.reason: The Supreme Court imposed no sentence; it set aside the High Court order and remitted the matter.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Supreme Court accepted no mitigating factors; compromise was rejected.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Victim aged seven; offence described as a crime against the dignity and body of a woman
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: These are crimes against the body of a woman which is her own temple
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The judgment stresses gravity and the victim's age, which the value marks as none.

other_sentence_order.reason: Matter remitted, respondent to be taken into custody forthwith, and appeal to be heard afresh.
